svg.title: Category vs. Image
svg.desc: Reference category uses the text encoder; images use the image encoder. Distant chairs are outliers, while one misplaced stool remains close to the reference cluster.
svg.metadata: Adapted from https://storage.googleapis.com/demo-dataset-quality-public/article/category_vs_image_transparent.png. Original composition retained. Higher-resolution product photos recovered from https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech/. Two bed photos replaced with clearer references from the same demo and original similarity figure; product roles unchanged. Embedding positions are illustrative, not measurements. Style: Qdrant shared figure tokens at dbf49e1e0f2a5e8369070adf895cc552c2f04814.
